title: Modi govt's Gen Z outreach: One Union minister to visit one university every day
content: The proposed initiative, called 'One Day, One University', is aimed at strengthening the government's engagement with young people. During these visits, ministers are expected to hold discussions with students, hear their views on issues affecting the country and explain government schemes meant for students and young people. The plan comes at a time when student protests over the NEET paper leak issue have intensified in  parts of the country.

title: Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award
content: In a remarkable showcase of talent, Taiwanese inventors made waves at the Silicon Valley International Festival. Among them, a ten-year-old prodigy captured prestigious awards with his innovative AI-powered electronic nose, designed to identify airborne chemical threats and health risks. The event highlighted the impressive achievement of Taiwanese participants, who collectively earned twenty-four gold medals, demonstrating the practical benefits of emerging technologies in daily life.

title: 3 killed, 3 injured after truck gas tank explodes at Delhi CNG station
content: A fire service officer said all six injured people were taken to hospital, where they were receiving treatment. Further information about the rest three is awaited. Fire service personnel also took precautionary measures at the station and worked to bring the situation under control. The cause of the explosion has not yet been established. An investigation is underway to determine what led to the gas tank bursting.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18
content: Starting September 18, 2026, new regulations from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services will affect Green Card applications, implementing a more rigorous public charge test. This means applicants will be assessed more thoroughly regarding any public benefits received. However, existing Green Card holders and certain humanitarian cases will not be subject to these enhanced evaluations.

title: Virginia moves refuge parking lot 2.5 miles so dunes and saltmarsh can return
content: Chincoteague National Wildlife Refuge is relocating its beach facilities to a more secure northern position following significant storm damage. This proactive approach not only aims to cut future repair costs but also accommodates the natural shifts of the island. While new parking arrangements will be established, the former site will transition back into its native ecosystem.

title: Former bishop's Indiana home with private chapel hits market for $1.28m
content: After nine years of dedication, an Indiana family has lovingly restored a historic home that once served as a Catholic bishop's residence, complete with a private chapel. Purchased at auction in 2016, they meticulously preserved its original features and completed extensive renovations. Now listed for $1.284 million, the family is ready to embark on new adventures and explore the world.

title: US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call
content: Better Home & Finance is suing former CEO Vishal Garg in a US court. The company seeks to block Garg from gathering shareholder support for his return. Garg allegedly violated securities laws by making misleading statements to regain his position. The board unanimously removed Garg after significant company losses and stock decline. Garg seeks reinstatement, offering to work for one dollar annually.

title: Kangana warns on relationships: Links Bengaluru case to westernised culture
content: Kangana Ranaut reacted to the Bengaluru murder case, where a woman and her lover allegedly killed her husband and five-year-old son, warning against "westernised" relationship culture on Instagram. She criticised normalising "body counts" and trends like ghosting, cautioning that a "blue drum" tragedy could hit anyone's family. She's currently seen in 'Bharat Bhagya Vidhata'.

title: Jinnah, Partition & a secret: 2 Mumbai doctors to receive Pakistan’s top honour
content: Pakistan will honor two Parsi doctors from Mumbai with its highest civilian award.  These physicians kept Muhammad Ali Jinnah's terminal illness a closely guarded secret.  Their professional confidentiality potentially safeguarded Pakistan's creation in 1947.  This act of discretion is considered a significant historical secret.  The doctors' names remain undisclosed by the Pakistani minister.

title: Galle conquered, boxes ticked: India’s Test blueprint takes shape
content: The 165-run win over Sri Lanka on Day 5 gives India one too many positives from Galle that they would love to carry to Colombo. Devdutt Padikkal's sublime century in the first innings, Manav Suthar's ten-wicket haul and Prasidh Krishna's steady improvement hint that India's Test team is shaping up really well under captain Shubman Gill.

title: MP teen killed for testicles after viral reel claimed they could fetch millions
content: A social media hoax about selling human testicles for crores allegedly inspired a murder. Police identified a BBA student as the mastermind who convinced others of the false claim. The 16-year-old victim was lured away and fatally stabbed, with his testicles removed. The accused kept the body parts on ice for two days while searching for a buyer. Investigations found no link to organized organ trafficking rackets.

title: Ajaz Khan backs Govinda; slams Sunita Ahuja and warns of hit to kids’ careers
content: Ajaz Khan has publicly sided with Govinda amid his conflict with Sunita Ahuja. He urged Ahuja not to share personal marital grievances online, emphasizing that Govinda's fame has been built on the support of his fans and the blessings from his mother. Khan believes that there are individuals trying to exploit Sunita Ahuja to undermine Govinda. Interestingly, reports indicate that Ahuja has decided to retract her divorce petition against Govinda.

title: ICC Test rankings: Harry Brook reclaims No.1 as Jasprit Bumrah retains top spot
content: Harry Brook has reclaimed the top spot in the ICC Test batting rankings. Jasprit Bumrah retained his position as the world's leading Test bowler. Bangladesh players saw significant gains after their historic victory over Australia. Afghanistan's dominance in the ODI series also resulted in player ranking movements. Several players from both teams achieved career-best rankings following recent performances.

title: Vietnam announces overhaul to speed up housing, infra projects: What changes
content: The Vietnamese government is set to fast-track development initiatives, enabling quicker land acquisition and construction even before compensation arrangements are complete. This strategy aims to eliminate obstacles and facilitate economic expansion. Residents impacted by these projects will be prioritized for new homes in their former neighborhoods. Additionally, the government will establish clearer criteria for land acquisition and ensure transparency in valuation processes.

title: Von Miller fulfills Cowboys dream as CeeDee Lamb is linked to Megan Denise
content: Achieving a childhood goal, Von Miller has signed with the Dallas Cowboys, a move he believes will enhance the team's performance. However, the situation has grown complicated, as his ex-girlfriend Megan Denise was recently linked to teammate CeeDee Lamb. This relationship could stir locker-room dynamics, introducing an unforeseen twist to the Cowboys' plans for a successful season.

title: Brooklyn Beckham takes special inspiration from father David amid family feud
content: Brooklyn Beckham recently displayed torso tattoos reminiscent of his father David's collection. Some of these tributes now seem altered or faded, suggesting a growing distance. The aspiring chef shared the images after a recent run and time at home. This follows Brooklyn skipping the family's annual yacht holiday for a second year. The Beckham parents were recently seen in St Tropez, not far from Brooklyn.

title: Travis Kelce's reckless driving confession sparks controversy
content: Travis Kelce’s account of a 2007 car crash is drawing attention after he revealed how reckless driving put his teammates and others at risk. While driving a borrowed minivan, Kelce lost control and hit three parked cars, leading to a suspended license. Years later, he openly accepts responsibility for the incident and uses it as a warning to young drivers. Thankfully, everyone involved escaped serious injury.

title: BWF Worlds: Displaced by war, Yevheniia and Polina keep Ukraine's flag flying high
content: Ukrainian badminton players Yevheniia Kantemyr and Polina Buhrova were forced to flee their war-torn hometown of Kharkiv to continue their careers in Italy. Despite personal loss and displacement, they are competing at the BWF World Championships in New Delhi, proudly representing Ukraine and voicing strong opposition to Russian athletes' participation in sport.

title: Luka Dončić’s $25,000 move helps young athletes keep their dreams alive
content: Luka Dončić's foundation is excited to present a new grant program dedicated to supporting young athletes aged twelve to fifteen. This initiative is designed to alleviate financial burdens by offering funding for training, equipment, and travel costs, enabling aspiring sports stars to thrive. Interested applicants have until August 20, 2026, to submit their applications for this promising opportunity.

title: Akshaye Khanna set to return in 'Mahakali'
content: Akshaye Khanna will portray Shukracharya in the upcoming 'Mahakali' movie. The film is part of the Prasanth Varma Cinematic Universe. Makers announced a major reveal date for August twenty-fourth. Bhoomi Shetty and Rohit Saraf also join the cast. This project builds upon the success of 'Hanu-Man'.

title: World Test C'ship: What India's Galle win means for their road to The Oval
content: The win came in India’s first Test assignment since their 0-2 home series loss to South Africa in November last year. The rain-affected match went into the fifth day after India had taken control of the contest.

title: Aryan Nishad’s Bribes FYI shuts down after going viral, seeks help to return
content: Bribes.fyi, the crowdsourced anti-bribery platform created by Aryan Nishad, has been temporarily shut down after going unexpectedly viral, recording more than 5 million requests and around 200,000 new users in 48 hours, according to a LinkedIn update. The team says it plans to return after putting stronger legal and financial infrastructure in place. The development has also prompted calls for lawyers and Chartered Accountants to help address concerns around verification, misuse, privacy, legal risks and platform governance.

title: Manav Suthar creates history: Youngest Indian to take 10-wicket haul in away Test
content: Manav Suthar became the youngest Indian to take ten wickets in an away Test. His performance secured India's victory against Sri Lanka in Galle. Suthar joined an elite group of Indian spinners with this achievement. Captain Shubman Gill praised the young bowler's promising future contributions. This win earned India crucial World Test Championship points.

title: 2 failed attempts, video call: How 'Rs 1.2 crore testicle' claim led to teen's murder
content: A 16-year-old boy was murdered in Bhopal by a group believing his testicles were valuable. The alleged mastermind was inspired by a social media hoax about organ prices. Police recovered the decomposed body and confirmed the removal of body parts. Divers are searching two lakes for the missing organs as evidence. The accused posed as a doctor to convince associates of the false plan.

title: Sean Strickland turns Dustin Poirier’s viral IGBBMN phrase into a gym craze
content: Sean Strickland adopted Dustin Poirier's viral airport phrase, turning it into a running joke.  His gym teammates began shouting the acronym together, which became a team chant.  Strickland also put the phrase on merchandise and spray-painted it onto his truck.  He initially criticized Poirier's public statements about his struggles.  However, Strickland later expressed sympathy and defended Poirier's sponsorship situation.

title: Crude oil shock may squeeze affordable housing but premium homes stay resilient
content: Amid geopolitical uncertainties, India's real estate sector shows promising strength. A robust demand alongside improved developer finances is likely to mitigate immediate pressures. The luxury housing segment is expected to stay stable despite affordability hurdles, while both office leasing and industrial warehousing are anticipated to flourish. Continued institutional investment bodes well for the sector's long-term growth trajectory.

title: PNG push: Govt to offer distributors cheaper domestic gas for every new connection
content: Approved by the government and effective from September 1, the benefit will apply to new domestic PNG connections added above a specified threshold for each geographical area. India has around 17.4 million domestic PNG connections at present.

title: Cabinet clears 4 railway projects worth Rs 9,450 crore across 4 states: Key details
content: The Union Cabinet greenlit five significant infrastructure initiatives totaling over thirteen thousand crore rupees. Among these, four railway multitracking projects will extend the network by four hundred ten kilometers, alleviating congestion and enhancing freight transport across various states. Additionally, an NH-22 highway upgrade project in Bihar will improve the eighty-two kilometer stretch, bolstering connectivity with the Nepal border.

title: Navi Mumbai road rage: Ola driver thrashed, dragged 2km on car bonnet
content: A road rage incident in Nerul involved an Ola cab driver being assaulted. The cab driver was struck with a bamboo stick, causing severe head injuries. He then lay on the car's bonnet to prevent the attacker's escape. The accused car driver sped away with the injured man on the hood. Police have registered an FIR and are searching for the absconding driver.

title: Manav Suthar's ten-wicket haul floors Sri Lanka as India conquer Galle challenge
content: Manav Suthar's second Test five-for and Devdutt Padikkal's maiden century powered India to a crushing 165-run win over Sri Lanka in in the first Test Galle. The young left-arm spinner stamped his authority on a dramatic second session, picking up three wickets in an over to wrap up Sri Lanka's second innings quickly.

title: Russia turns to Asia for refined fuel, set to receive nearly 270,000 tonnes in Aug
content: Russia is importing refined fuel from Asian nations this month. Ukrainian attacks on its oil refineries have reduced domestic fuel production significantly. India supplies about one-third of these crucial refined fuel imports. These shipments use ship-to-ship transfers to obscure their origins. Russia has also tightened its own fuel export curbs to manage shortages.

title: 'Series of disobedience': Arrest warrant issued against Moitra in hate speech case
content:
The case relates to comments Moitra made at a news conference in Nadia in Aug 2025

NEW DELHI: A Bengal court on Wednesday issued an arrest warrant against Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Mahua Moitra for allegedly failing to honour summons in a hate speech case. The case relates to comments Moitra made at a news conference in Nadia in Aug 2025 while speaking about infiltration along the India-Bangladesh border.
